transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because… I keep getting stuck checking my work. Spreadsheets, calculations, that kind of thing. I’ll go over them again and again, even after I know I already checked, and sometimes I’m still there hours after everyone’s left. It just feels like if I don’t check one more time, something bad might happen and it would be my fault.
When you’re not able to check your work again, how does that make you feel? Do you get anxious or upset?

Yeah… I do. I get really anxious. It’s like I can’t let it go, because if I don’t check the spreadsheet or the numbers one more time, I feel like something bad could happen and it would be on me. Even if I already looked it over, it still bothers me.
Do you ever have thoughts that come into your mind that you don’t want or that bother you, like fears of making a mistake even when you know you did things right?

Yeah… that happens. Even when the numbers match, I’ll get this thought that maybe I missed some hidden mistake, like in payroll or taxes. Like someone’s check won’t go through, or the firm will get in trouble. I try to ignore it, but it just comes back, and then I feel like I can’t really trust what I saw.
Can you tell me more about those thoughts? Do they feel like they’re coming out of nowhere or do they seem connected to something real that could actually happen?

It’s… sort of connected to real things, I guess. Payroll and taxes do matter. But the thought feels like it just jumps in even after I’ve already seen the numbers match. Like maybe there’s one hidden mistake I missed, and then someone’s check won’t go through or the firm could get in trouble. I try to push it away, but it comes right back, like I can’t trust my own eyes.
Do these thoughts lead you to do certain things, like checking or redoing your work, to try to make sure everything is perfect or to ease the anxiety they cause?

Yeah… I mean, that’s mostly why I’m here. I keep going back over the same spreadsheets and calculations, even after I already checked them. Sometimes I stay late after everyone else leaves because I feel like I have to do it one more time. If I don’t, I get this feeling that something bad will happen and it’ll be my fault.
Do you feel the need to do anything else besides checking your work, like counting, repeating words, or following certain routines, even if they don’t seem directly related to what you’re working on?
Um… not really, I don’t think. It’s mostly the checking. I haven’t noticed myself doing counting or saying words or anything like that.
If something stopped you from being able to check your work again, like a power outage or someone taking your computer, how would that make you feel?

I’d feel really panicky, I think. Like… I know I already checked it, but if I couldn’t go back one more time, I’d just keep thinking something bad was going to happen and it would be my fault. I’d probably be stuck on it for hours.
Outside of work, do you find that these thoughts or the need to check things interfere with your daily life, like your relationships, free time, or how you feel about yourself?

Yeah… it has. I missed a filing deadline at work and got called into a formal meeting about it, which was… embarrassing.

And I’ve stopped making it to choir rehearsals and some youth-center stuff because I can’t get out of the office on time. I don’t really like admitting that, but… yeah, it’s affecting things.

Do you ever have any mental rituals or other repetitive thoughts or behaviors—like silently repeating a word, praying, or mentally reviewing events—that you feel you must do to prevent something bad from happening?

Mostly it’s… going back over the spreadsheets and calculations. I don’t really do prayers or words in my head.

But I do feel like I have to check them again and again, even when I already know I looked. If I don’t do it one more time, I get this feeling that something bad could happen and it would be on me. Sometimes I stay after everyone’s gone because I can’t let it go.
When you check your work again, does it feel like you’re undoing or preventing something bad from happening, almost like if you don’t do it, the bad thing becomes more real or more likely?

Yeah… I think so. It feels like if I don’t go back over the spreadsheet or the numbers one more time, then something bad is more likely to happen, and it’ll be my fault.

Even if I already checked it, I can’t really… trust that. I end up staying there for hours sometimes, just checking the same things again.
Do you ever feel that something bad might happen even when you logically know it's very unlikely, like a specific fear that doesn't seem to make sense but still feels very real?

Yeah… I guess. Even when I can see the numbers match, I’ll still get this thought that maybe there’s one mistake I didn’t catch, like in payroll or taxes.

It doesn’t really make sense, but it feels… real enough that I can’t just ignore it. I try to push it away, and then it comes right back, like I can’t trust what I already checked.
Do these thoughts about making a mistake feel intrusive and unwanted, like they don’t really belong to you or you wish you could stop having them?

Yeah… they do feel unwanted. Like, I’ll know the numbers match, but then the thought just jumps in that I missed some hidden mistake in payroll or taxes.

I don’t want to think it, but it comes back anyway, like I can’t really trust what I just saw.
